import.title: Daily OTB
import.description: OTB (on the books) is the number of rooms booked for each upcoming night, from your PMS. With OTB you get your own pickup, pace versus 4 weeks earlier, same time last year (STLY) and a forecast, and price suggestions use it too.

otb_report.label: Daily rooms-on-the-books report
otb_report.body: One row per night: rooms booked, revenue, rooms available (optional: as-of date, cancellations, group rooms). Import once a day; days don't overwrite each other, which gives you pickup.

bookings.label: Detailed bookings file
bookings.body: One row per booking: booking date, arrival, departure, cancellation date, status, rooms, revenue. The past OTB is rebuilt from it, so pickup, pace and STLY are available right away.

import.asOfHint: Empty = today. Use it when re-importing an older day's report.
import.roomsHint: Optional: use when the file has no rooms-available column.
import.noSelf: Add your hotel (role “Your hotel”) under <link>Hotels</link> before importing OTB.
import.invalidRooms: Rooms available must be a whole number above 0.

result.summary: Read {rows} rows · wrote {snapshots} snapshots · {asOf} as-of dates · {stays} nights
result.done: OTB now shows in <pace>Booking pace</pace> and <today>Today</today>.

panel.title: Your OTB
panel.info: OTB = rooms booked for each night, from your PMS. Pickup = rooms added (net of cancellations) versus 1 or 7 days ago. Versus 4 weeks earlier = current OTB versus the same weekday 4 weeks earlier, at the same days before arrival. Same time last year (STLY) = the same weekday 364 days earlier, at the same days before arrival. Forecast = OTB + average historical pickup from now to arrival (same weekdays).
